text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So, the leaves wilted because I used too much fertilizer?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Overfertilizing plants can give them fertilizer burn and damage them.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… I just wanted them to grow up big and strong…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Not to fear. They'll recover as long as you fix their growing environment. Just be mindful moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But just like how overfeeding a plant can hurt it, we must also take care to adhere to a healthy diet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Being careless with your nutrition can negatively affect performance. I have seen many a student desperately running laps in order to get back into shape.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-you make a very good point…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I think I've been snacking a little too much lately…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower becomes more mindful of the different foods she eats, and successfully manages to balance her diet again.
